_readme: The hollow's first fight, fought with a sword - The Barred Gate: Arena, which this directory names.
Everything up to the fight is two_in_the_hollow.json's own road, step for step, taken from it
when this was written: the same maps, the same companion, the same gap. What changes is the
encounter, which opens the arena because this game's CombatDef says so, and fight_well plays it.
It is the only session that drives the arena through a real encounter on a real map.

steps.text: fetch Rook: south to the well, west to the wall, south to her

north up the wall and through the west door. The hold CARRIES past the warp - an arriving leg keeps walking in the next map - so the next leg re-anchors against the hollow's own geometry rather than assuming where this one stopped.
south down the east side until the wall, then west along the only row that reaches the gap the slink is standing in

the slink pair, fought with the sword. fight_well plays the arena the way the balance gate's PERFECT does - lines up on the nearest foe, swings when the blade will land, waits out a flash at arm's length and steps away from a touch - through the real keys
a swing is a sound only the arena makes, so it is what proves the fight that just ended was the arena rather than the turn fight
the whole party earns the award - the turn fight's rule, through the same lines - but only the leader stood on the floor, so Rook's health is exactly what it was when she joined
